tools.name: cart_add_item
tools.description: Adds units of one product to an anonymous Trailhead Supply cart and returns the whole cart. Without cart_token a new cart is opened and its cart_token returned. tools.name: cart_update_item
tools.description: Sets how many units of a product an anonymous Trailhead Supply cart holds and returns the whole cart; qty 0 removes the product. The product must already be in the cart. A raised quantity is checked against stock as on the website.

tools.name: cart_remove_item
tools.description: Removes a product from an anonymous Trailhead Supply cart and returns the whole cart. Removing a product the cart does not hold leaves the cart as it is.

tools.name: cart_view

tools.name: show_products
tools.description: Chosen Trailhead Supply products named by public_id, drawn as cards, or as a recommendation: groups by placement with the product, swaps, accessories and a live total. Names, prices and stock are the store's.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, list_categories, get_store_info · Private data: get_product, find_documents, get_store_info · Public sink: get_store_info · Destructive: cart_remove_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, list_categories, get_store_info · Private data: get_product, find_documents, get_store_info · Public sink: get_store_info · Destructive: cart_remove_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
